                                                      SPARKLE Intel® Arc™ A580 ORC OC Edition, 8GB GDDR6, ThermalSync™, TORN
                                                      Cooling, Axial Fan, Metal Backplate, SA580C-8GOC

                                                      The SPARKLE Intel Arc A580 ORC OC Edition is ready to level up your performance. Experience
                                                      advanced fast-paced gaming and unleash your creativity with brand new Intel Arc A580.
                                                      ORC Series equipped TORN Cooling with double customized AXL fans, 2.2-slot design and full-metal
                                                      backplate for compatibility with all types of gaming case. ORC series also has patented(pending)
                                                      ThermalSync™, which allow users monitor their GPU temperatures at all times.
